items.title: Habtoor Tower installs final facade panel ahead of phased handover
items.summary: The 1,740-unit Sheikh Zayed Road tower finished its glass facade in October; more than 1,300 apartments are due first in a phased handover.

items.title: Nakheel appoints Mar Marine for beach works at Bay Villas
items.summary: Marine works on Island B add 320 m of beach near the 636-home villa and townhouse community and upgrade about 3 km of shoreline, finishing by Q4 2027.

items.title: H&H starts construction on 32-villa Eden House Dubai Hills
items.summary: Dutco Construction is on site at the community of 32 five- and six-bedroom villas; no completion date was given.

items.title: Grovy under construction on Ramada Residences at Dubai Islands
items.summary: Work began in August with Jaseera Building Contracting as main contractor on furnished one- to three-bedroom homes and four-bedroom penthouses; handover is set for Q3 2027.

items.community: Shams Abu Dhabi, Al Reem Island
items.title: Missoni to design 250-home waterfront tower on Al Reem Island
items.summary: The fashion house's first homes in the capital: 250 freehold one- to four-bedroom apartments and five-bedroom penthouses, with completion planned for Q2 2030.

items.title: Swiss Property brings Kempinski branded homes to Dubai Creek
items.summary: Listed among September launches: 285 residences in two buildings, from one-bedroom apartments to four-bedroom duplexes. Another report gives 279 apartments.

items.title: Meraas awards AED 590m contract for City Walk Crestlane Phase 3
items.summary: Parkway International will build 394 apartments in four buildings; construction has begun, with completion expected by Q3 2028.

items.title: Nakheel awards AED 800m-plus contract for Bay Grove Phases 1 and 3
items.summary: Metac General Contracting will build 537 one- to four-bedroom homes across seven buildings, with main works due to finish in late 2028.

items.title: Ground broken on AED 3bn Dubai Creek Gardens
items.summary: More than 1,400 residences on a 127,000 sq m creekside site, including the UAE's first Westin and Renaissance branded homes, with completion set for 2030.

items.title: Azizi enters Sharjah with AED 30bn Azizi Florence
items.summary: Six clusters with 1,130 villas, more than 6,000 townhouses and 3,500 apartments; three-bedroom townhouses reported from AED 1.89m, though later listings show AED 2.09m.

items.title: Hausen Development lists HAUS 99 in JVT
items.summary: 99 residences from studios to four-bedroom townhouses and duplexes, with handover in Q4 2028.

items.title: Pearlshire Development lists Bond Living in DLRC
items.summary: Studio to three-bedroom apartments of 543 to 2,271 sq ft, with handover in Q3 2028.

items.title: Lotus Living lists Grosvenor House in Dubai South
items.summary: One- and two-bedroom apartments of 639 to 1,055 sq ft, with handover in Q2 2027.
